description: University Grants Commission - Amendment to the Institute for Agro-Technology and Rural Sciences Ordinance
reasoning: This gazette content contains an ordinance made by the University Grants Commission under Section 18 of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends the University of Colombo, Institute for Agro Technology and Rural Sciences Ordinance. This constitutes legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and amendments to existing legislation, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
